title: VerifierCard
description: Static catalog entry for one verifier (P3). Carries IRT-GRM-inspired quality stats and the surface / kind metadata used by the committee aggregator. Discovery and validation happen at catalog.load_cards() time, never at module import — the schema gate runs in the verify-framework-edit step.

name.description: Unique verifier name across the registry. Used as the dispatch key.

surface.description: Behavioral surface for kind=behavioral; empty string for non-behavioral verifiers.

cost.description: Unitless cost (0.0+); used in IRT-GRM-inspired score as 1/(1+cost).

recipe.description: Path to a dedicated per-verifier recipe. Empty string when no dedicated recipe exists.

stats.description: Quality statistics feeding card_score: discrimination * consistency * (1/(1+cost)) - fuzz_penalty.

discrimination.description: IRT-GRM-inspired discrimination (0.0–1.0). Higher = better at separating pass vs fail.

consistency.description: Self-consistency across reruns (0.0–1.0). Higher = more stable.

fuzz_penalty.description: Penalty subtracted for false positives under fuzz (>=0). Higher = more penalty.

n_observations.description: Number of historical observations backing the stats (>=0).
